newsitem.title: USA: NYS changes policy, picks GO refunding syndicate.
newsitem.headline: NYS changes policy, picks GO refunding syndicate.

text.p: New York State's Comptroller announced Friday a change of policy designed to let the state more quickly seize on any possible bond refunding opportunities by picking a syndicate to stand ready.

"In the past we had selected underwriters on a case-by-case basis. This time, we wanted to have the team in place so we could jump on refundings," said Steve Greenberg, a spokesman for the state comptroller.
A prepared statement from the comptroller added, "There are no refundings currently contemplated."
The six co-senior managers that were selected are: Bear, Stearns & Co, Goldman, Sachs & Co, Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch & Co, PaineWebber, and Smith Barney Inc.

Additional co-managers are: First Albany Corp., JP Morgan, Morgan Stanley Dean Witter, Prudential Securities, Advest, Artemis Capital Group, Fleet Securities, WR Lazard, Laidlaw Inc., Samuel A. Ramirez & Co, Roosevelt & Cross, Siebert Brandford Shank & Co, William E. Simon & Sons Municipal Securities.
